structural_preflight_without_prose_extra.parser: Python standard-library xml.etree.ElementTree on the 21 exact XML objects; no external DTD resolver or network access

extraction_contract.unit: one document per frozen PMCID.version, ordered exactly as frozen_records
include: direct article-meta abstract elements with no abstract-type or an empty abstract-type; exclude abstract-type=web-summary
the direct article body subtree, including section headings and prose text
text inside ordinary inline formatting elements
extraction_contract.article_title: exclude; it is source metadata rather than abstract/main-body prose
extraction_contract.xml_safety: verify frozen size/MD5/SHA-256 before parsing; reject entity declarations; parse the exact source bytes without loading external subsets or resolving external entities
extraction_contract.text_normalization: Unicode NFC; collapse every run of Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space; strip leading/trailing whitespace; UTF-8 encode; one line per complete article document
extraction_contract.empty_or_identity_mismatch: record failure; do not substitute. Stop if fewer than 20 complete documents remain.
extraction_contract.retention: corpus text, source documents, and extracted text remain in ignored data/ and are never committed

duplicate_policy.contract: Use the existing schema-4 preparation implementation unchanged: retain every source row; identify documents by Unicode NFC followed by collapsing internal Unicode whitespace to ASCII spaces; place normalized duplicates in the same split; record duplicate identity SHA-256 and source-row counts.

split_contract.allocation: existing deterministic schema-4 largest-remainder allocation after reserving at least one unique document in each split
split_contract.held_out_identity_freeze: record exact PMCID.version-to-normalized-identity-SHA256 mappings for validation and test in the result inventory before model evaluation or tuning; do not open the test split for Q11 baseline selection

tokenizer_contract.name: byte-bpe-v1
tokenizer_contract.algorithm: deterministic byte-level BPE; initial byte IDs 0-255, BOS=256, EOS=257, PAD=258; merge adjacent byte/token pairs independently within each training document; never merge across document boundaries or merge special tokens
tokenizer_contract.selection_and_ties: at each step choose the most frequent adjacent pair; break equal-frequency ties by the lexicographically smallest numeric (left_token_id, right_token_id); replace all non-overlapping occurrences left-to-right; stop at target vocabulary or when no pair meets the frequency floor
tokenizer_contract.fit_input: only data/q10-prep-002-a/train.txt or data/q10-prep-002-b/train.txt; the fit command accepts one training-file argument and has no validation/test input
tokenizer_contract.artifact: versioned tokenizer.json containing all merges, exact train-file SHA-256, training document identity hashes, byte count and merge settings; artifact SHA-256 is recorded in the result inventory and each run
tokenizer_contract.acceptance: fitted artifacts from preparations A/B have identical contents and SHA-256; load/save round-trip succeeds; encode/decode round-trips every document in all splits; byte coverage equals source UTF-8 byte length
tokenizer_contract.model_vocab_size: set each future run config to the actual fitted artifact vocabulary size; do not assume the target was reached

hypothesis: The frozen 21-record source can be extracted and split twice with identical source, text, duplicate, split and manifest hashes, and a deterministic byte-level BPE artifact fitted only on the training documents will be identical across both preparations.
change: Add a secure deterministic PMC XML prose extractor, make schema-4 output bytes use canonical UTF-8/LF line endings, implement byte-bpe-v1 and a fit-tokenizer command that receives only train.txt, and load the fitted data-dir tokenizer artifact in training while preserving legacy fixed-byte behavior.
control: Q10-SOURCE-007's 21-document restricted-prose rights pass and Q10-PREP-001 schema-4 split/duplicate tests on synthetic fixtures. This is a data-preparation reproducibility control, not a capability control.

training_budget.tokenizer_fit: bounded CPU byte-pair counting on the training split only; no model optimization

evaluation_metrics: frozen XML size/MD5/SHA-256 and identity checks
document extraction count and source-to-extracted-text SHA-256 mapping
normalized duplicate group and row counts
train/validation/test document counts and exact normalized identity hashes
A/B source, text, manifest, split, tokenizer-input, and tokenizer artifact SHA-256 equality
tokenizer fit-source SHA-256 and training identity list
tokenizer vocabulary/merge count and train-only input contract
Unicode encode/decode round trips and byte coverage across all splits
zero model training tokens, updates and FLOPs
result: Pending. No article prose has been extracted for corpus preparation.
interpretation: Pending. Rights clearance authorizes only the frozen abstract/main-body scope; deterministic extraction, split identities and the train-only tokenizer remain to be verified.
next_experiment: After Q10-PREP-002 passes, freeze Q11 task contracts and hand-checked scorers, run contamination checks against training/validation/test identities, then produce bounded fresh conventional-baseline results before any sequence-block campaign.
